description: Hellbender 100 plan - week 1

workoutSteps.description: NOT a run day — the gap is deliberate while running frequency climbs. Week 1: lay out every pair you own and press a thumb into the back of each heel counter. Anything stiff, high, or with a seam over the Achilles goes in the bin, not the rotation — that shoe is what caused the 2026 bursitis. Then the usual 15 min of ankle, calf and hip work, plus heel-lock lacing practice.

Single-leg RDL 3x8/leg
ECCENTRIC step-down 3x10/leg, 4 s lowering

Side plank 3x40 s
Done. Eat protein within the hour.
